findings.summary: Each index can now be wrapped by its own operator-managed key, optionally living in the customer's own AWS account via role_arn + external_id. Shipped in v0.17.0. Directly answers the ICP's key-custody requirement: the customer holds the key, <YOUR_COMPANY> never does.

evidence.note: Positioning claim: keys live in the customer's KMS; <YOUR_COMPANY> never sees or escrows a customer key.
ICP must hold their own encryption keys and pass 'who could read this vector?' audits.

findings.summary: EXAMPLE_APP_API_KEY is now optional; without it example-app runs free-tier with a 1,000,000-item-per-index cap. Removes the procurement step from evaluation, which the ICP names as friction.

evidence.note: Evaluation friction matters: time-to-first-query under five minutes, no procurement step to evaluate.
